verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Railway's MCP server lets assistants "manage environments, pull variables," plus a claim of unlimited environments. That implies Railway stores and manages environment variables per environment, but it is a single thin mention reached through the AI tooling. missing for 10: team-level access control/RBAC, secrets management, centralized/shared variable management docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
